term: accessible failure of full headless actual causal ancestry coverage
definition: There is a world accessible from the selected standpoint at which not every existing individual has a headless full ancestor cone generated by finite paths in the existing actual causal graph. This is a substantive OPEN modal opportunity, not a finding from observed finite causal prefixes, an exclusion of every infinite branch, or an assertion of sourcehood at the selected standpoint.
note: Source-free branching-network reconstruction. Reuses actualGraph and actual-node subtype plus HeadlessFullAncestry with the same Ontic.Causes at the selected possible world. No causal ontology is changed, and no causation-grounding identification is made. Applicability to survey A2 chain language, causal capability/concreteness of candidates and real metaphysical possibility remain independently open. Failure of the universal excludes an empty possible actual-node domain without a separate population assumption; it does not assert a temporal beginning.
